threat_event: Client CEII or BCSI on the project platform is accessed by staff or attackers without a need to know
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Project-wide group permissions; client BCSI found in personal cloud storage on 2 of 25 sampled projects
regulatory_driver: Client contracts (CIP-011-3 and CIP-004-7 R6 flow-down); 18 CFR 388.113(g)(1)
treatment_plan: Restricted CEII and BCSI folders with client-approved access lists; block personal cloud storage (POAM-020)
owner: Engineering Services security and compliance lead

threat_event: Ransomware halts project delivery across offices
treatment_plan: Segment the 14 offices; quarterly restore tests

threat_event: Engineer credentials stolen and used on SYS-G4 to reach client or affiliate OT
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 230 accounts with standing access; contractors not deprovisioned automatically
treatment_plan: Just-in-time access per work order; automatic deprovisioning (POAM-001, POAM-002)
owner: Engineering Services security and compliance lead

threat_event: Misconfigured project platform storage exposes client files
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Provider B accounts partly outside group guardrails
treatment_plan: Guardrails on all provider B accounts

threat_event: Commissioning laptop infected and connected to a client substation
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 900 laptops; client pre-connection checks vary
regulatory_driver: Client contracts (CIP-010-4 R4 and CIP-003-9 Att. 1 Sec. 5.2 flow-down)
treatment_plan: Allowlisting on all laptops; pre-connection attestation report per site (POAM-023)

threat_event: Client is not notified within contract deadlines of an incident affecting its data or access
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No register of 37 contracts' notice terms; SOC findings not routed to the contracts team
existing_controls: Contracts team handles notices case by case
treatment_plan: Notice register; routing from the SOC; include in the P08 tabletop (POAM-021)

threat_event: Client loses trust after a security finding in the first SOC 2 Type 2 report
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Type 2 observation starts 2027-01-01; several criteria partially ready (P09)
owner: Engineering Services security and compliance lead

threat_event: Generative AI design assistant leaks client CEII or produces faulty design content
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Pilot used with client documents before approval; no client consent terms
existing_controls: Approved-tools list; enterprise terms with no training on inputs
treatment_plan: Block client CEII and BCSI from the assistant until client terms allow; engineer review attestation (POAM-022)

threat_event: Personnel risk assessments for engineers with client access are incomplete
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: PRA records kept by office HR; seven-year renewal not tracked centrally
treatment_plan: Central PRA register with renewal alerts

threat_event: Group controls Engineering Services relies on are undocumented for clients and auditors
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Inheritance matrix missing; SOC 2 description lists SYS-G1 to SYS-G3 only
treatment_plan: Inheritance matrix including SYS-G4 and group HR (POAM-017)
owner: Engineering Services security and compliance lead

threat_event: Federal contract information handled without the FAR 52.204-21 controls on a new tool
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No clause register; new tools adopted without FAR review
treatment_plan: Clause register; FAR check in tool approval

threat_event: Employee personal information exposed through HR exports at offices
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Office HR keeps spreadsheet exports for PRAs
regulatory_driver: State breach laws (each state where employees reside)
treatment_plan: Remove local exports after the central PRA register goes live

threat_event: Subcontractor payment diverted by email fraud
regulatory_driver: SEC internal control over financial reporting

threat_event: Client relay settings altered before delivery
threat_source: Attacker or error in the design environment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Settings files stored on SYS-S1 without integrity checks
treatment_plan: Signed settings files with hash verification at delivery

threat_event: Departed engineer keeps access to client portals
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Client portal accounts managed by clients; no notice process when engineers leave
treatment_plan: Notify clients within one business day of departures (contract terms)

threat_event: Project platform outage during a client outage window

vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Drawings synced locally for field work
treatment_plan: Accepted by the division security and compliance lead (encrypted devices)
owner: Engineering Services security and compliance lead

vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Several teams answer client security questionnaires
treatment_plan: Single answer library tied to the SOC 2 description
owner: Engineering Services security and compliance lead
